title: Uniform attachment with freezing: Scaling limits — Lean formalization
abstract: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of arXiv:2308.00484, "Uniform attachment with freezing: Scaling limits", published in Ann. Inst. H. Poincaré Probab. Statist. 61(4) 2679–2708 (2025). It proves the Introduction's height theorem, the subcritical Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov (GHP) limit to a measured segment, the critical GHP limit to a random compact measured real tree T(f) together with its geometric properties (leaves carry the mass; binary if and only if the reciprocal-square integral diverges; root condensation otherwise), and the supercritical distance-matrix limit in its corrected zero-diagonal form. All numbered intermediate results are proved, several in corrected or qualified forms. The CRT corollary (cor:CRT) is not formalized. Height and forward-tree modules are adapted from the companion formalization of "Uniform attachment with freezing" by the same contributor (not yet public; see docs/companion-provenance.md).
